emergency.title: In an emergency, 112
emergency.text: If you have thoughts of harming yourself or are in an emergency, call 112 (or your local emergency number) right away.

help.title: Yeşilay Helpline 115 (YEDAM, Türkiye)
help.text: Provides free counselling on addiction to individuals, their families and anyone who wants information; it also covers technology addiction and can arrange an appointment in your province if needed. You can ask on the line about the scope of help for this issue.

help.title: Psychiatry appointment (MHRS, Türkiye)
help.text: You can get an appointment at a psychiatry clinic or with a clinical psychologist. For hospital appointments you can call the ALO 182 (MHRS) line or use the MHRS / e-Nabız app.

expert.title: When should you see a professional?
expert.text: If the behaviour clearly affects your work, studies or relationships; if you've felt anxious or low for a long time; or if you're finding it hard to cope alone, talking to a professional can help.

supporter.title: Write to your supporter
supporter.desc: Send a neutral message to someone you trust. The messages contain no details.
templates: I'm going through a hard moment right now, can we talk?
I'm feeling a bit lonely this evening, shall we go for a short walk?
I'm working on a goal; it would help me to message you now and then.

summary.title: Show a professional
summary.desc: A summary of your urge and slip statistics, screening results and triggers. It's created on this phone; you decide where to send it.
summary.privacy: The summary file is not encrypted. Share it only with a professional you trust, through a secure channel.
summary.failed: The summary couldn't be created. You can try again.
